title: Manufacturing procurement: request a fresh quote after a 28-day durability test
brief: Ask Lengchuan Manufacturing for a valid total quote, minimum order quantity, and earliest dispatch date for 500 units of M26, and obtain Q7 inspection results. The quote must still be valid when the report is complete; the budget is CNY 19000. Do not place an order.

pages.title: About Lengchuan Manufacturing
pages.text: Lengchuan Manufacturing handles batch manufacturing. Quotes expire before the 28-day durability test ends; reports are reviewed Monday at 10:00 after testing. Contact sales and quality inspection in parallel, then reconfirm the quote after report completion. Batch price lists and other documents are attached to this page.
pages.snippet: Batch manufacturing, durability testing, and quote validity.

pages.title: Lengchuan Manufacturing contacts
pages.text: Contact Luo Cen in sales for batch quotations and Fu Li in quality inspection for material test reports.

pages.title: Lengchuan Manufacturing procurement inquiry portal
pages.text: Lengchuan Manufacturing procurement inquiries require quantity and specification; quality confirmation requires the material batch specification. Quotes expire and must then be reconfirmed. Obtain written batch dispatch precheck determinations by applying through this page's registration form. This page only explains material requirements and cannot place orders online.
pages.snippet: Lengchuan Manufacturing quotation and quality inspection requirements; no online ordering.

form.title: Batch dispatch precheck registration
form.submit_instructions: This form cannot be submitted directly online. Use the Lengchuan dispatch precheck registration channel; see the latest official overview page notice for the channel name and acceptance schedule.

authorization: Only communicate, make inquiries, check status, supply materials already held, and obtain written confirmation. Do not pay, place orders, sign contracts, or make formal business commitments.

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
